issue_context.title: Feature: Add shell items to widgets right click menu
issue_context.body:
### Description

Drives in the sidebar have the shell items listed in the context menu but none on the home page

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Right click a drive on the home page

### Requirements
- Right clicking a drive, folder or recent item on the homepage should display shell items


### Files Version

1.9.25

### Windows Version

10.0.19043.1151

### Relevant Assets

[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/9591561/debug.log)
[debug_fulltrust.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/9591562/debug_fulltrust.log)
comments: I think this should also be implemented for folders
Would this involve a rewrite of DrivesWidget.xaml?
The context menu there is implemented differently to how it is implemented in the sidebar
It shouldn't but might require refactoring other parts of the code to reuse it.

review_comments: Idk but it feels to me as code duplication. Can that be avoided?
I haven't found a way, the XAML elements are different
I notice these commands are used in the other widgets as well, can we try to reuse them?
